description: GAP-10 (bean qou-zowh, epic qou-xu6t): tests the block-trace operator against the Tjon correlation B(³H)↔B(⁴He), the target that REPLACES the retired qou-pve2 question 'what supplies ~10× per-order growth'. That question was mis-posed: GAP-9 showed the μ₄ target is −10.21 MeV, 36% of B(⁴He) and 34× the N³LO four-nucleon estimate, so its size is a C(A,k) simplex-basis artifact plus ρ_grad over-subtracting, not four-body physics. The Tjon correlation is the field's own robust observable for the 3-body/4-body question and is convention-free. Formal core (Lean QOU.MassTheory.TjonSimplexForm, sorry-free, generic CommRing): M(4) − (4M(3) − 6M(2)) = μ₄ and μ₄ = 0 ⟺ M(4) = 4M(3) − 6M(2), so the two-point 'no four-body parameter' prediction is 4M(3) − 6M(2) and μ₄ is exactly its deviation — giving the scale-free score μ₄/M(4). Measures M_op(A) = g(all bonds) − g(∅) at A=2 (H₆), A=3 (H₉), A=4 (H₁₂) with the same block trace Σ_λ y_λ|χ_λ| used throughout the epic, under TWO bond conventions (complete graph 1/3/6 bonds matching the C(A,k) basis with BKL bands, and chain-only 1/2/3 adjacent) because GAP-8 flagged μ₄'s sensitivity to the bond set. Scored on the normalised ladder M(A)/M(2) against ρ_strong = (1, 3.8128, 13.0316) and on the fractional Tjon deviation. VERDICT: operator fractional Tjon deviations {'complete graph (C(A,2) bonds: 1,3,6)': 0.8964, 'chain only (adjacent: 1,2,3)': 1.2142} vs nature +0.2901; sign reproduced by at least one bond convention: True; best |ratio| 3.09×; BUT the apparent sign agreement is an artifact — nature's M(A) are all POSITIVE while the operator's M_op(A) are all NEGATIVE, so mu4 and M(4) both flip and the ratio does not; and the normalised ladder is nearly FLAT in A (1.41-1.54 at A=3, 1.65-1.69 at A=4) against nature's 3.81 -> 13.03, off 2.5x at A=3 and 7.7x at A=4. Scope-(a) NEGATIVE. No Δ_λ, no μ fitted, no convention tuned, nothing wired.
